name: Movies and Actors Dataset (actors.xml)
description: XML dataset of movies with associated actor biographical information. Each movie entry contains an internal identifier, a movie title, a date, and a list of actors. For each actor, the dataset records the actor's name and may additionally include the actor's birthday and birthplace.

variableMeasured.name: movie/id
variableMeasured.description: Internal dataset identifier for the movie entry (e.g., 'actors_1').

variableMeasured.name: movie/actors/actor/name
variableMeasured.description: Actor name associated with the movie. This element may occur multiple times per movie.

variableMeasured.name: movie/actors/actor/birthday
variableMeasured.description: Actor birthday when provided in the dataset.

variableMeasured.name: movie/actors/actor/birthplace
variableMeasured.description: Actor birthplace when provided in the dataset.

variableMeasured.name: movie/date
variableMeasured.description: Date associated with the movie entry as stored in the dataset (format appears as YYYY-MM-DD).
